spans.s: एल एल, अम्, n. a particular number.

एला एला, f. cardamoms, the seed of the
Elettaria Cardamomum or Alpinia Cardamomum, it
applies to both the large and small cardamom, but
more commonly to the former; N. of a river; N. of a
metre consisting of four lines of fifteen syllables each.
—एला-पत्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a Nāga.
—एला-पर्णी,
f. the plant Mimosa Octandra.
—एला-पुर, अम्, n.,
N. of a town.
एलद, अम्, n. a particular number.
एलक एलक, अस्, m. a ram. See एडक.
एलाक, अस्, m., N. of a man.

एलङ्ग एलङ्ग, अस्, m. a kind of fish; [cf.
एरङ्ग.]
एलपुर एलपुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.

एलवालु एलवालु, n. or एलवालुक or एल्ववा-
लुक, अम्, n. the fragrant bark of Feronia Elephantum;
a granular substance, apparently a vegetable of a red-
dish-brown colour (it is used as a drug and perfume).

एलविल एलविल, अस्, m. an epithet of Ku-
vera. See ऐलविल.

एलाय एलाय (less correctly इलाय), nom.
P. एलायति, -यितुम्, to be wantonly mischievous or
wild in behaviour, to be merry.
